sync.intro: Common Text can sync across your machines — one transport, one copy of the data.

folder.name: Local folder
folder.description: commontext.json in a cloud-drive folder; picks up external changes.

git.name: Git repository
git.description: Private repo, periodic commits — real history, visible conflicts.

server.name: Self-hosted service
server.description: Your own sync server over HTTP/WebSocket, token auth.

none.name: Off · local only
none.description: No transport. Items stay on this machine.

blocked.gitToken: Configure an access token first (stored in the OS keyring).
blocked.serverUrl: Enter the server URL first (include the scheme).
blocked.serverToken: Configure a server token first (stored in the OS keyring).

baseline.description: Both sides already hold data, and their revision numbers come from different transports so they cannot be compared. Pick which side to trust for items that differ. Nothing is deleted either way.
baseline.runsNote: Runs one full re-sync before saving
baseline.explain: This device wins — local items overwrite the remote; remote-only items are pulled in. Remote wins — remote items overwrite local; local-only items are pushed as new.

folder.filePathDescription: A commontext.json inside a synced folder. Writes go through a temp file + atomic rename, so a reader never sees half a file.
folder.watchDescription: Refresh the list when another device (or the cloud client) changes the file.

git.remoteDescription: Private repository. A failed push never blocks local use; the reason shows in the sync panel.
git.tokenConfigured: Configured. The token lives in the OS keyring; settings.json only stores hastoken: true.
git.tokenNotConfigured: Stored in the OS keyring, never in settings.json.
git.intervalDescription: Periodic commit + pull. Sync now in the status panel runs one immediately.

server.urlDescription: Include the scheme. For a LAN server use http://192.168.1.10:8787 and enable Allow insecure below.
server.tokenConfigured: Configured. The token lives in the OS keyring; settings.json only stores hastoken: true.
server.tokenNotConfigured: Server auth token, stored in the OS keyring.
server.pushModeDescription: Realtime uses WebSocket when available and falls back to polling.
server.insecureDescription: Permits plaintext connections (LAN or self-signed). Keep this off on the public internet.

none.title: Local only
none.description: No transport is configured. Items live in the local database and nothing is uploaded.

serverStatus.title: Server status
serverStatus.versionDescription: Protocol version is the hard compatibility gate; app version is informational only.
serverStatus.dataDescription: Counted at the last check. Your local cursor sits behind until the next sync runs.
serverStatus.realtimeSupportedDesc: The server accepts WebSocket push; edits go out without waiting for a sync tick.
serverStatus.realtimeUnsupportedDesc: Not implemented on the server transport yet — edits go out on save, or on the next tick.
serverStatus.unreachableSuffix: . Retries on the normal interval; local edits keep working.
serverStatus.checkDescription: Same checks the CLI runs — every failure carries an executable fix command (wsh commontext-sync doctor).
serverStatus.copyProtocolMismatch: Copy the protocol mismatch for an AI to resolve
serverStatus.copyDiagnostics: Copy the server diagnostics for an AI to diagnose

device.title: This device
device.nameDescription: Shown as the Computer of new items. Renaming does not rewrite history: old items keep the name they were created with.
device.idDescription: Generated once and never changes, so a renamed machine is still recognized as the same device.

live.title: Status
live.noRunYet: No run yet — syncs every {{minutes}} min once configured.
live.copyFailureTitle: Copy the last sync failure for an AI to diagnose
live.pendingDescription: Items the remote has not confirmed yet; the next sync sends them. 0 means everything is uploaded.
live.conflictsDescriptionSome: Conflict details can be copied to an AI; nothing is overwritten. (CLI equivalent: `wsh commontext-sync conflicts --copy`.)
live.copyConflictsTitle: Copy all {{count}} conflicts for an AI to merge
live.nowDescription: Run one sync immediately instead of waiting for the timer.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: conflicts · scope · maintenance

rowMerge.title: Merge per row, mark only real conflicts
rowMerge.description: Auto-merge when possible; only a same-field double edit becomes a conflict.

newest.title: Newest wins
newest.description: Take the newer updatedat and silently overwrite the older side.

manual.title: Always ask
manual.description: Stop and ask on every conflict; syncing stays paused until resolved.

advanced.scopeCommonTextDescription: This release syncs Common Text only. Other domains (settings, notes, sessions) are out of scope.
advanced.tombstonesDescription: When off, a delete stays local and the other machine pushes the item back.
advanced.resyncDescription: Ignore the local cursor and reconcile the whole remote snapshot once.
advanced.resetDescription: Clears the local cursor and rev cache only. Items and the remote file are untouched.

statusMsg.savedBlocked: Saved, but sync will not start: {{reason}}
statusMsg.switchedWithError: Switched, but the first sync reported: {{error}}
statusMsg.resyncQueued: Full re-sync queued. Progress shows in the sync panel.
statusMsg.resetNote: Reset clears the local cursor and rev cache only.

savebar.draft: Draft — nothing is written until Save.

agentAccess.introSuffix: Snorkeling (Claude Code, Codex, pi) read and navigate this app. External processes never receive the app's own key: they get a short-lived scoped token that you can revoke here.
agentAccess.nameDescription: Shown in the audit log, so make it recognisable.
agentAccess.scopesDescription: Least privilege: observe is read-only. Destructive is never issued.
agentAccess.scopeHintObserve: Read UI state, blocks, sessions, cards
agentAccess.lifetimeDescription: Short is better. Expiry is enforced by the signed token itself.
agentAccess.saveToDescription: Written 0600, never displayed. Point your host's env var here.
agentAccess.generateDescription: Creates the token and writes the file. Nothing is printed to the terminal.
agentAccess.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{label}}? The agent's next call will be refused.
agentAccess.noTokens: No token has been created yet.
agentAccess.installSkillDescription: Copies the bundled skill into the agent directories that exist on this machine (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.agents).
agentAccess.hostDescription: Pick the agent host you are configuring.
agentAccess.auditSuffix: (time, command, agent name, jti prefix, allowed/denied). Tokens are rate limited to 60 calls per minute. The MCP transport is stdio only — no port is opened.
agentAccess.noticeNameRequired: Give the agent a name so the audit log can attribute calls.
agentAccess.noticeTokenSaved: Token for "{{name}}" saved to {{path}} ({{scopes}}). The token itself is never displayed.
agentAccess.noticeNoSkillDir: No agent skill directory found. Install manually with: wsh agent install-skill --root <dir>
agentAccess.noticeMcpCopied: MCP config copied. Paste it into your agent host's config file.

secrets.emptyHint: Add a secret to get started
secrets.nameRule: Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores
secrets.notShownNote: The current secret value is not shown by default for security purposes.

agentNotify.intro: Snorkeling raises a native toast when an agent finishes or asks for input. These switches control how often that happens.
agentNotify.masterDescription: Master switch for every agent toast.
agentNotify.doneDescription: A working agent became idle — the turn completed.
agentNotify.blockedTitle: Notify when an agent needs input
agentNotify.blockedDescription: The agent is blocked, for example on an approval prompt.
agentNotify.blockedAria: Notify when an agent needs input
agentNotify.focusedTitle: Notify even while Snorkeling is focused
agentNotify.focusedDescription: By default a toast is skipped when a Snorkeling window has focus.
agentNotify.focusedAria: Notify even while Snorkeling is focused
agentNotify.idleDescription: Wait until the keyboard and mouse have been idle this long before notifying. 0 notifies right away.
agentNotify.cooldownDescription: Repeat toasts of the same kind inside this window are merged into one summary. 0 disables the cooldown.

agentNotifications.name: Agent Notifications
agentNotifications.description: OS toasts for agent done / blocked

agentAccess.name: Agent Access
agentAccess.description: Scoped tokens for agents outside the app

aiPrompts.name: AI Prompts
aiPrompts.description: Prompts for AI-generated session title / note & tags

view.copyJsonError: Copy this JSON error for an AI to fix

model.discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard and continue?
model.jsonMustBeObject: JSON must be an object, not an array, primitive, or null
model.invalidAiKeyPrefix: Invalid key "{{key}}": all top-level keys must start with "ai@"
model.invalidKeyChars: Invalid key "{{key}}": keys must only contain letters, numbers, underscores, @, dots, and hyphens
model.storageBackendUnavailable: No appropriate secret manager found. Cannot manage secrets securely.
model.secretNameInvalid: Invalid secret name: must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores

aiPrompts.title: AI Prompts
aiPrompts.subtitle: Override the system prompt per feature. Empty fields keep the built-in default.
aiPrompts.resetTooltip: Clear overrides and use the built-in prompt
aiPrompts.systemPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt
aiPrompts.extraPlaceholder: Appended after the system prompt, e.g. reply in Chinese
aiPrompts.enabledTooltip: When off, the card button reports a disabled error
aiPrompts.autoTitleDescription: Runs a serial, throttled background worker that title-cases sessions which still only have a raw first-message title. Each session is generated at most once; a hand-renamed title is never overwritten. Off by default to avoid spending model quota unexpectedly.

waveAi.noModesHintPrefix: Add a provider from a template above, or edit
waveAi.selectModeToEdit: Select a mode to edit it.
waveAi.endpointHint: Base URL and full request URL both work. A base URL such as https://host/v1 is expanded to the right path automatically.
waveAi.secretHint: Save the key itself in Settings → Secrets under this name.
waveAi.deleteProviderMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? The entry is removed from waveai.json. Existing sessions that already use it keep working until their mode is switched.

templates.openaiResponses: Newer OpenAI Responses API models. Replace the endpoint when using a proxy.
templates.openaiChat: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoints. Replace the endpoint when using a proxy.
templates.anthropic: Claude models through the Anthropic API. Replace the endpoint when using a compatible gateway.
templates.googleGemini: Gemini models through Google AI. The model name is part of this endpoint.
templates.openrouter: Many models through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
templates.custom: Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM, or a private gateway

hero.intro: Heroes live in one root directory: a git-tracked home base each. Point that root at a bigger disk, keep an eye on what syncs, and cap how far a single hero may grow.
hero.rootDirDescription: Empty means the default ({{defaultRoot}}). Must be an absolute path — a relative path would resolve against the app's working directory.
hero.resolvedDescription: Where the app reads hero homes right now (saved value, not the draft above).
hero.noHeroesDescription: Create one with `wsh hero create --name <name> --yes`, or let an agent propose one.
hero.totalDescription: archive + history are the only buckets that cross machines; work stays on this disk.
hero.journalRotateDescription: Move journal lines from earlier months into MEMORY/archive/YYYY-MM.md; the live file keeps the current month only.
hero.dormantDescription: Days without a shift before the roster flags a hero as dormant.
hero.softLimitDescription: A warning threshold, not a hard cap — nothing is deleted when a hero crosses it.
hero.softLimitActionTitle: When the soft limit is crossed

softLimitAction.warnDescription: Show the size in the roster; the hero keeps working.
softLimitAction.distillDescription: Warn, then fold old memory entries into the distilled summary.
softLimitAction.readonlyDescription: Block new memory writes until the hero is under the limit again.

hero.relocateRowDescription: Changing the root above only tells the app where to look; existing hero homes stay on the old disk. Run the dry-run first — it lists every directory and size and writes nothing.

relocateNote.apply: to apply (per-directory move, file-count and byte check, rollback of the already-moved part on failure).
relocateNote.keepCopy: keeps a copy at the old root. When
relocateNote.envSuffix: is set, settings are not rewritten — the env var wins.

hero.validateRootRelative: Root directory must be an absolute path (or empty for the default).
